ELWYNN SURVIVAL FOR WINDOWS
===========================

A co-op survival game on the "benilla" client, which uses the art and sound from your own
World of Warcraft 1.12.1. This folder has no WoW files in it: you need a 1.12.1 install (a
folder with WoW.exe and Data\dbc.MPQ in it). Newer WoW Classic installs will NOT work.

PLAY    Double-click Play. The first time it asks where your WoW 1.12.1 is; then it opens the
        game on the group's server, logged in. When a new version is out it updates itself
        first. Move the mouse over it for "Play alone" (your own world on this PC) and the cog:
        your name, someone else's server, the other game, a test copy that plays the newest main.

HOST    Only for whoever runs a server for friends. Double-click Host, leave its window open,
        and give out the address it prints; friends put it under Play's cog ("Someone else's").
        Over the internet, your router forwards TCP 3724, 8085 and 8086 to this PC.

The first time, Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click More info, then Run anyway.
Your heroes live on the server you play on. Your own worlds are in server\saves: copy that folder
to keep them. Your choices are in settings.txt. If something goes wrong, play.log beside Play
says what happened.

Source, releases and the rest: https://github.com/slopmaster69/Basin-Battle
Licences: licenses\ (the code is MIT or Apache-2.0; the two typefaces are under the OFL).
